description: Schedule on the first day of every month

transformTemplates: ($release := $lookup(versions, $.'dist-tags'.latest); $exact := /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/; $runner := $replace($release.dependencies.vitest, /^=/, ''); $core := $replace($lookup($release.dependencies, '@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core'), /^=/, ''); $assert($exists($match($release.version, $exact)) and $exists($match($runner, $exact)) and $exists($match($core, $exact)) and ($release.deprecated ? false : true), 'Vite+ latest must declare exact stable runner and core versions'); {'releases': [{'version': '{{{packageName}}}' = 'vite-plus' ? $release.version : '{{{packageName}}}' = '@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core' ? $core : $runner, 'releaseTimestamp': $lookup(time, $release.version)}], 'sourceUrl': 'https://github.com/voidzero-dev/vite-plus', 'homepage': 'https://viteplus.dev'})

customManagers.description: The setup-uv version input is handled natively by github-actions; extract only the uvx tool pin here
Track the versioned Changesets configuration schema, not the CLI version

packageRules.description: Project every toolchain target from the same Vite+ latest manifest, never from standalone Vitest/core releases. Wait for that Vite+ release together; no older-release fallback. Example Vite stays independent. Rollbacks are disabled because this datasource intentionally exposes only the target, not historical versions.
Keep CLI/action major migrations and the independently versioned schema in one PR
Keep packageManager pins in the root and independent examples together with the installer action
Preserve the published library's compatibility floor, including when dev dependencies are pinned
